resources.string: Lapho usebenzisa Ukuvula Ngesigxivizo Somunwe, imifanekiso isetshenziselwa ukuvuselela imodeli yakho yesigxivizo somunwe. Imifanekiso esetshenziselwe ukusungula imodeli yesigxivizo somunwe wakho ayilokothi igcinwe, kodwa imodeli yesigxivizo somunwe igcinwa ngokuphephile kwithebulethi yakho futhi ayilokothi ishiye ithebulethi. Konke ukucubungula kwenzeka ngokuvikelekile kwithebulethi yakho.

Uma isebenzisa Ukuvula Kwesigxivizo Somunwe, imifanekiso isetshenziselwa ukubuyekeza imodeli yayo yesigxivizo somunwe. Imifanekiso esetshenziselwe ukusungula imodeli yesigxivizo somunwe wakho ayilokothi igcinwe, kodwa imodeli yesigxivizo somunwe igcinwa ngokuphephile kwithebulethi yakho futhi ayilokothi ishiye ithebulethi. Konke ukucubungula kwenzeka ngokuvikelekile kwithebulethi yakho.
Ungasula imodeli yakho yezigxivizo zeminwe, noma uvale Ukuvula Izigxivizo zeminwe noma nini Kumasethingi. Amamodeli wesigxivizo somunwe agcinwa kwithebulethi kuze kube yilapho uwasula.
Wena nengane yakho ningasula imodeli yesigxivizo somunwe wayo, noma uvale Ukuvula Ngesigxivizo Somunwe noma kunini Kumasethingi. Amamodeli esigxivizo somunwe agcinwa kuthebulethi aze asulwe.
